dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Nearly linear spline fitting the trailing edge with negligible concavity.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Acute shape classification with a minimal pixel radius at the highest morphological point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: High angular steepness, approximately 75 degrees relative to the horizontal body axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Maximum vertical pixel height exceeds maximum horizontal base width by a factor of approximately 2.5.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Convex arc with a moderate radius of curvature on the dorsal cranial boundary.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Extremely elongated and thin pixel projection extending from the melon inflection point.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Prominent obtuse interior angle at the pixel coordinate where the melon slope transitions into the rostrum.

other_distinctive_markers: Symmetrically elongated and narrow pectoral fins that mirror the morphology of the dorsal fin and rostrum.
